model.name: Overtime v1
model.summary: A recurring crown-time game in one canonical WETH/token pool where opt-in buys take the lead and immutable deadlines settle pull-based rewards.
model.userOutcome: Traders may swap normally or route an exact-input WETH buy through the challenge router to take the crown; a leader can win a Knockout bonus while every crown holder earns by crown-seconds.
model.whyV4: The fee, authenticated challenge intent, actual settled-volume check, expiry-before-swap transition, refunds, and rollback must execute atomically inside the canonical PoolManager swap lifecycle.

builder.licenseDeclaration: Original Overtime source is MIT-licensed; pinned dependencies retain their upstream licenses.

project.name: Overtime v1
project.description: A recurring leader-time game implemented by one immutable fee-enforcing Uniswap v4 hook.

tokenCreation.actor: OvertimeLauncher deployAssets validates committed creation-code hashes and deploys the fixed-supply token.
tokenCreation.valueFlow: The full 1,000,000,000 token supply is minted once for initial liquidity formation.
tokenCreation.custody: The launcher holds the fixed supply between the authority-gated asset-deployment and liquidity-lock transactions; it has no transfer or rescue surface.
tokenCreation.failure: Any bytecode, salt, ordering, or hook-mask mismatch reverts asset deployment; the token cannot be used by the canonical hook until launcher-only initialization.

poolInitialization.actor: OvertimeLauncher initializes the exact canonical PoolKey once.
poolInitialization.valueFlow: No fee or reward moves during initialization; the committed starting price is written to PoolManager.
poolInitialization.custody: PoolManager owns canonical pool state and the hook admits only this PoolKey.
poolInitialization.failure: Wrong key, hook mask, price, initializer, or PoolManager rejection reverts the complete liquidity-lock transaction.

liquidityFormation.actor: OvertimeLauncher mints one explicit bounded v4 position.
liquidityFormation.valueFlow: Launch WETH and the fixed token supply enter the canonical position with explicit maximum inputs and a finite deadline.
liquidityFormation.custody: LockedLiquidityVault permanently owns the position and exposes no removal, transfer, approval, rescue, or withdrawal path.
liquidityFormation.failure: Slippage, deadline, amount, transfer, or ownership mismatch reverts the complete launch.

initialTransaction.notApplicableReason: The launch has no privileged initial buy; the first post-launch trade uses the same ordinary or challenge rules as every later trade.

trading.actor: Any PoolManager-compatible router may make an ordinary trade; only OvertimeChallengeRouter may submit a challenge intent.
trading.valueFlow: Every accepted swap pays 10 bps Programmable plus 100 bps game in actual gross WETH; a challenge also pays the current crown cost.
trading.custody: The hook controls PoolManager WETH claims while recording separate category liabilities.
trading.failure: Invalid key, callback, data, mode, minimum, partial fill, slippage, or accounting state reverts the complete swap.

feesAndClaims.actor: The immutable Programmable owner and each recorded game beneficiary pull only their own entitlement.
feesAndClaims.valueFlow: PoolManager WETH claims redeem the exact Programmable, champion, crown-time, or refund liability.
feesAndClaims.custody: The hook ledger remains authoritative; no raw balance is assigned to a category.
feesAndClaims.failure: Unauthorized, zero, double, reentrant, or failed-recipient claims revert without changing liability.

dependencyFailure.actor: Any caller encountering PoolManager, PositionManager, WETH, or token failure.
dependencyFailure.valueFlow: No value movement is accepted when a required dependency call fails.
dependencyFailure.custody: Existing liabilities and the locked position remain unchanged by a reverted action.
dependencyFailure.failure: Fail closed and retry the user action later; no fallback, rescue, or administrator path exists.
dependencyFailure.event: No event is emitted for a reverted dependency failure.

retirement.notApplicableReason: V1 is immutable, non-upgradeable, and permanently locks initial liquidity; claims remain pull-based without a retirement or migration authority.

pool.orderingRule: The launcher accepts only a mined token address greater than WETH, making WETH currency0 and the launched token currency1.
pool.alternativePools: Alternative pools may exist and do not inherit this model's behavior.

hook.poolNamespace: One hook instance admits one immutable PoolKey shape and derives exactly one PoolId; every liability still includes that PoolId.

poolAdmission.enforcement: Every callback compares currency0 WETH, currency1 launched token, zero LP fee, tick spacing 200, and hooks equal to address(this).
poolAdmission.factoryOrRegistry: OvertimeLauncher is the sole immutable initializer; deployAssets verifies the hook mask and launch initializes the precommitted key before locking liquidity.
poolAdmission.alternativePoolBehavior: Alternative pools may exist but cannot enter this hook, accrue game state, or inherit any Overtime claim.
poolAdmission.rejectionRule: Any changed PoolKey member reverts before fee or round state changes.

callbackPolicies.necessity: Authenticate the only canonical PoolKey initialization across the two gas-bounded launcher phases.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Any non-launcher sender or changed PoolKey member reverts before PoolManager records a starting price.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: Initialization occurs once before users can trade or acquire an entitlement; no later claim or exit invokes this callback.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: The hook never initializes a pool itself and the immutable launcher is the only accepted callback sender.

callbackPolicies.necessity: Finalize expired rounds before processing and collect specified-WETH fees; validate authenticated challenge intent before core execution.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Wrong PoolKey, fee quantum, malformed or unauthorized hookData, unsupported challenge mode, deadline, minimum, or arithmetic failure reverts the swap.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: Ordinary empty-data swaps remain permissionless; a rejected challenge can be retried as an ordinary swap or with corrected authenticated parameters.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: The hook exposes no PoolManager swap path, so self-call callback suppression cannot bypass fee or game accounting.

callbackPolicies.necessity: Collect fees when WETH is unspecified and validate specified-WETH actual core fill plus challenge settled volume before committing the swap.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Partial fill, gross-up, final delta, challenge minimum/output, backing, overflow, or state mismatch reverts the complete unlock.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: A failed swap preserves every prior liability and entitlement; claims use a separate bounded pull path and are not routed through afterSwap.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: Hook-initiated claim unlocks contain no swap, so skipped self callbacks cannot change fees, rounds, or liabilities.

hookData.schema: abi.encode(uint8 version=1,uint8 mode=1,address player,uint256 expectedGrossWeth,uint256 minTokenOut,uint256 deadline)
hookData.validation: Reject wrong version, mode, length, player, direction, exactness, gross amount, deadline, partial fill, minimum WETH, or trailing bytes.

feeMechanism.chargedCurrency: WETH (currency0) in all four quadrants, with before/after path selected by whether WETH is specified.

zeroForOneExactInput.formula: Cumulative 110 bps of gross specified WETH; core receives gross minus fee and the final fill must match exactly.

zeroForOneExactOutput.formula: Gross up executed WETH input so the hook receives cumulative 110 bps and the caller pays the gross amount.

oneForZeroExactInput.formula: Cumulative 110 bps is removed from executed gross WETH output and the caller receives the net amount.

oneForZeroExactOutput.formula: Gross specified WETH output equals requested net output plus cumulative 110 bps, with exact fill required.

recipients.derivationRule: The OvertimeHook itself owns game-pot accounting for the canonical PoolId.

feeMechanism.ownership: The immutable Programmable owner controls only its liability; game entitlements are determined solely by immutable round rules and beneficiary pull claims.
feeMechanism.claimPolicy: Programmable chooses a per-call destination; champion, crown-time, and refund beneficiaries may claim only their own entitlement and cannot redirect another address.

customAccounting.backingSource: Every returned WETH fee delta is backed by a same-unlock PoolManager ERC-6909 WETH claim minted to the hook.
customAccounting.conservationEquation: hook-controlled WETH claims equal or exceed programmable plus pending plus active plus finalized champion plus finalized crown-time plus refund liabilities.
customAccounting.settlement: During the callback the hook takes the exact positive WETH fee delta as an ERC-6909 claim; claims later burn/settle that claim and take WETH to the beneficiary in one unlock.
customAccounting.partialFillBehavior: Specified-WETH partial fills revert after comparing actual core WETH with the expected fee-adjusted amount; unspecified-WETH fees use the executed delta.
customAccounting.liabilityNamespace: chain 1, Overtime v1, canonical PoolId, WETH, category or beneficiary, and round epoch where applicable.
customAccounting.duplicateCurrencyPolicy: Only WETH is a fee and reward currency; no second pool or currency namespace is admitted.
customAccounting.failureIsolation: Any delta, transfer, liability, or redemption failure reverts the complete PoolManager unlock.
customAccounting.withdrawalOrdering: Clear the exact beneficiary liability before burning/settling hook claims and taking WETH; a failed external transfer reverts both effects.

specifiedComponent.formula: Cumulative 110 bps WETH fee on gross specified exact input; residual core input is gross minus fee.
specifiedComponent.minimum: Zero only when the applicable gross WETH amount is zero.
specifiedComponent.maximum: Less than the applicable gross WETH amount and representable as int128.

positiveSettlementActions.amountRule: Exactly the positive beforeSwap specified WETH fee delta.

zeroForOneExactInput.rounding: Independent cumulative platform/game floors; both lifetime remainders are retained.
zeroForOneExactInput.partialFillRule: AfterSwap compares actual core WETH with gross minus fee; any partial fill reverts atomically.
zeroForOneExactInput.slippageInvariant: The router checks final token output after the hook fee and challenge mode also checks exact settled gross WETH.
zeroForOneExactInput.failureRule: Fee quantum, overflow, fill, challenge minimum, deadline, or backing mismatch reverts the complete swap.

zeroForOneExactOutput.rounding: afterSwap exact-output gross-up uses full-precision ceiling math and retained stream remainders.
zeroForOneExactOutput.partialFillRule: Fee basis is the executed WETH input from the afterSwap delta; standard exact-output semantics and caller max-input bounds apply.
zeroForOneExactOutput.slippageInvariant: Final gross WETH input after hook effects must not exceed the caller's maximum input.
zeroForOneExactOutput.failureRule: Gross-up, overflow, fee quantum, backing, or final input-bound mismatch reverts the complete swap.

oneForZeroExactInput.rounding: afterSwap deducts cumulative platform/game floors from executed gross WETH output.
oneForZeroExactInput.partialFillRule: Fee basis is actual executed gross WETH output after any core partial fill.
oneForZeroExactInput.slippageInvariant: Final net WETH output after the hook fee must meet the caller's minimum output.
oneForZeroExactInput.failureRule: Fee quantum, overflow, backing, or final output-bound mismatch reverts the complete swap.

specifiedComponent.formula: Gross WETH output equals requested net WETH plus the cumulative 110 bps fee returned beforeSwap.
specifiedComponent.minimum: Zero only when the applicable gross WETH amount is zero.
specifiedComponent.maximum: Less than the applicable gross WETH amount and representable as int128.

positiveSettlementActions.amountRule: Exactly the positive beforeSwap gross-up WETH fee delta.

oneForZeroExactOutput.rounding: Full-precision ceiling gross-up with independent lifetime stream remainders.
oneForZeroExactOutput.partialFillRule: AfterSwap requires actual gross WETH core output to equal requested net plus fee; partial fill reverts.
oneForZeroExactOutput.slippageInvariant: Final net WETH output equals the requested exact output while token input remains under the caller maximum.
oneForZeroExactOutput.failureRule: Gross-up, fee quantum, overflow, fill, or backing mismatch reverts the complete swap.

afterSwap.backingSource: The executed unspecified WETH delta and a same-callback PoolManager WETH claim taken by the hook.

unspecified.formula: Positive cumulative WETH fee for quote-unspecified quadrants; zero for quote-specified quadrants already charged before swap.
unspecified.minimum: Zero only when the applicable executed gross WETH amount is zero.
unspecified.maximum: Less than the applicable executed gross WETH amount and representable as int128.

positiveSettlementActions.authorizationRule: Only the authenticated hook callback for the canonical PoolKey executes this take.
positiveSettlementActions.amountRule: Exactly the positive afterSwap WETH fee delta returned by the hook.

afterSwap.bounds: Zero through the cumulative 110 bps fee, strictly less than executed gross WETH and representable as int128.
afterSwap.rounding: Independent lifetime Programmable and game remainders; exact-output gross-up uses full-precision ceiling math.
afterSwap.slippageOrMinimums: Router validates the final caller delta; challenges additionally require exact fill, 0.01 WETH settled minimum, token minimum, and deadline.
afterSwap.failureRule: Overflow, fee quantum, gross-up, fill, or settlement mismatch reverts the complete swap.

erc6909Claims.owner: OvertimeHook owns the PoolManager WETH claim; its internal ledger adds the sole canonical PoolId and beneficiary/category namespace.
erc6909Claims.operatorPolicy: No operator or transferable beneficiary claim exists; only hook code can redeem its PoolManager claim.
erc6909Claims.mintFlow: During an authenticated swap callback the hook takes the exact WETH fee with claims=true, minting the currency-address ERC-6909 claim to itself.
erc6909Claims.burnFlow: A pull claim opens PoolManager unlock, settles by burning the hook's exact WETH claim amount, then takes underlying WETH to the authorized beneficiary.
erc6909Claims.takeSettleFlow: Fee accrual: return delta plus take(claims=true). Redemption: settle/burn hook claim, then take underlying WETH to beneficiary before unlock end.
erc6909Claims.liabilityKeys: Internal keys are canonical PoolId, WETH, category or beneficiary, and round epoch; Programmable also uses its immutable owner address.
erc6909Claims.transferPolicy: PoolManager claims and internal entitlements are non-transferable through OvertimeHook.
erc6909Claims.redemption: Only the exact liability-specific pull function may burn claims and pay its authorized recipient; no rescue or aggregate withdrawal exists.
erc6909Claims.roundingDust: Fee remainders remain explicit lifetime state and finalized crown-time division dust remains reserved; neither is inferred or swept.
erc6909Claims.aggregateSolvencyEquation: PoolManager WETH claim balance owned by hook >= programmable + pendingPot + activePot + unclaimed champion + unclaimed crown-time + refunds.

nestedActions.samePoolPolicy: same-pool swaps are forbidden and no hook entry point can initiate PoolManager.swap
nestedActions.crossPoolPolicy: No cross-pool action or PoolKey is accepted.
nestedActions.callbackSuppression: The only hook-initiated unlock is a claim redemption containing no swap, liquidity, or donate action.
nestedActions.stateCommitOrder: Finalize expired round, compute and record liabilities, take backing claim, return delta; claims clear liability before redemption.
nestedActions.transientDeltaOwner: The hook owns only the exact fee delta and challenge router owns user swap settlement deltas.
nestedActions.syncInterleaving: No ERC-20 sync interleaving is used for fee claims; PoolManager ERC-6909 claims are minted/burned in the same unlock accounting model.
nestedActions.slippageAggregation: The router checks final token output and exact settled gross WETH after hook effects.
nestedActions.failureAtomicity: Any nested take, settle, burn, transfer, or final-delta failure reverts its complete unlock.

valueFlows.to: OvertimeHook PoolManager WETH claim and category liabilities
valueFlows.amountRule: Exactly 10 bps Programmable plus 100 bps game of accepted actual gross WETH using independent lifetime remainders.
valueFlows.settlement: Quadrant-dependent before/after return delta backed by a same-callback PoolManager claim taken to the hook.
valueFlows.failure: Wrong key, fee quantum, gross-up, fill, overflow, or backing mismatch reverts the complete swap.

valueFlows.to: active pot or same-block refund liability
valueFlows.amountRule: clamp(activePot times 100 bps, 0.001 WETH, 0.10 WETH), paid on every valid challenge.
valueFlows.settlement: The router settles the exact WETH amount in the same PoolManager unlock and the hook records one matching liability category.
valueFlows.failure: Insufficient payment, wrong identity, partial fill, deadline, or accounting mismatch reverts the complete challenge.

valueFlows.to: immutable Programmable owner-selected destination or exact game beneficiary
valueFlows.amountRule: Only the caller-authorized Programmable, champion, crown-time, or refund liability is redeemed once.
valueFlows.settlement: Clear liability, burn or settle the exact hook claim, and take underlying WETH to the beneficiary before unlock end.
valueFlows.failure: Unauthorized, zero, double, reentrant, or failed-recipient redemption reverts and restores the liability.

valueFlows.from: launch caller and fixed token supply
valueFlows.to: canonical PoolManager position permanently owned by LockedLiquidityVault
valueFlows.amountRule: Explicit committed liquidity with amount0Max, amount1Max, starting price, and finite deadline.
valueFlows.settlement: After committed asset deployment, OvertimeLauncher atomically initializes and mints in the second bounded transaction, then verifies position ownership.
valueFlows.failure: Any price, amount, deadline, transfer, key, hook-mask, or ownership mismatch reverts the complete launch.

authorities.controller: any Ethereum address or compatible smart account
authorities.userExitImpact: May affect price and round pot through ordinary volume but cannot change another address's leader identity, deadlines, or claims.

authorities.controller: OvertimeChallengeRouter bytecode at the hook constructor-bound address
authorities.userExitImpact: Can only mediate exact-input WETH-to-token challenges and cannot redirect payer, player, beneficiary, or token output.
Cannot mutate fees, game state, other liabilities, pool configuration, or custody.
Can execute only the two committed one-shot phases and retains no authority after launch.

authorities.controller: each address recorded by immutable round accounting
authorities.userExitImpact: Cannot redirect or consume another beneficiary's historic entitlement.

onchain.name: Uniswap v4 PoolManager
onchain.trust: Immutable callback and flash-accounting authority for the one canonical PoolKey.
onchain.failure: A revert or runtime mismatch blocks swaps, launch, or claims fail closed.
onchain.fallback: No protocol fallback; users retry only after the exact dependency is available and matched.

onchain.name: Uniswap v4 PositionManager
onchain.trust: Creates and accounts for the initial permanently held v4 position.
onchain.failure: Any launch-time mint or ownership mismatch reverts the atomic launch.
onchain.fallback: No alternative position manager is accepted.

onchain.name: Wrapped Ether
onchain.trust: Canonical WETH ERC-20 transfer and balance semantics on Ethereum Mainnet.
onchain.failure: Transfer or runtime mismatch reverts swaps, challenges, launch, or claims.
onchain.fallback: No substitute quote currency is accepted.

onchain.name: Overtime Challenge Router
onchain.trust: The hook constructor binds exactly one deployed router; that router binds payer, player, beneficiary, and recipient to msg.sender.
onchain.failure: An absent or mismatched router prevents challenge mode while empty-hookData ordinary swaps remain available.
onchain.fallback: No alternative router is accepted by the immutable hook instance.

operations.monitoring: After an authorized deployment, monitor runtime hashes, canonical PoolId, hook mask, WETH claim solvency versus category liabilities, deadline ordering, claim failures, and event/indexer lag; monitoring cannot mutate contracts.
operations.incidentResponse: Fail affected product transaction preparation closed, preserve pull claims and chain truth, publish a factual incident record, and require a separately reviewed new immutable version for any repair.

integration.partialFills: Specified-WETH partial fills revert atomically; unspecified-WETH ordinary fees use actual executed delta; every challenge partial fill reverts.
integration.slippage: Ordinary routers enforce their final delta bounds; OvertimeChallengeRouter enforces minimum token output and exact settled gross WETH after hook effects.
integration.deadline: The challenge router requires a finite caller deadline and reverts at or after expiry; launcher liquidity also uses a finite deadline.
integration.permit2: Not used by the project challenge router; the caller grants only an exact WETH ERC-20 allowance to that immutable router. External ordinary routers own their separate approval policy.
integration.stateReads: Canonical PoolKey and onchain hook state are authoritative; later quotes and displays must read one coherent confirmed block.

dataReconstruction.eventCoverage: Launch identity, fee accrual and remainders, round starts/challenges/finalization, refund credits, and every claim are emitted with PoolId, round, and beneficiary keys.
dataReconstruction.startBlockPolicy: Begin at the confirmed launcher deployment block and require the exact launch event/provenance commitment.
dataReconstruction.reorgPolicy: Rollback all entities at and after the common ancestor, replay canonical logs in cursor order, then reconcile current onchain state at one confirmed block.
dataReconstruction.backfillPolicy: Permissionless deterministic replay from the launch block with bounded pages and no omission-as-absence assumption.
dataReconstruction.checkpointPolicy: Persist the confirmed block hash and cursor; discard a checkpoint whose block hash no longer matches canonical chain state.
dataReconstruction.freshnessMeasurement: Wall-clock age of the last confirmed reconciled block plus indexed head lag.
dataReconstruction.reconciliation: Compare event-derived round/liability totals with hook views and the hook's PoolManager WETH claim at the same confirmed block.

balanceSources: PoolManager ERC-6909 WETH claim balance owned by the exact OvertimeHook at one confirmed block
liabilitySources: OvertimeHook programmable, pending, active, finalized champion, finalized crown-time, and refund ledger views
reserveReconstruction.solvencyEquation: hook PoolManager WETH claim >= programmable + pendingPot + activePot + unclaimed champion + unclaimed crown-time + refunds
reserveReconstruction.donationAndDustPolicy: Pool donations and raw balances do not create a liability category; fee remainders and crown-time division dust remain explicit reserved state.
reserveReconstruction.reconciliation: Replay all accrual/finalization/claim events and compare each category plus aggregate liabilities to exact onchain views and claim backing.

platformHandoff.handoffNotes: After maintainers accept one exact prototype, separately scope registry, UI, API, reorg-aware indexer, executable V4Quoter, ordinary and challenge trade paths, claim UX, and solvency monitoring against the accepted release.

projectSurfaces.name: Canonical pool model
projectSurfaces.summary: The token, launcher, locked-liquidity vault, challenge router, canonical PoolKey, fee kernel, round state, and pull claims reviewed as one onchain boundary.

authority.summary: PoolManager callback authentication and the declared launch authorities bound in this submission govern the exact onchain boundary.
controls: Authenticate every hook callback through the exact PoolManager and declared pool-admission rule.

valueFlow.summary: All swap fees, crown contributions, reward claims, and initial liquidity use the four declared value-flow ids and conserve WETH/token value.
controls: Keep Programmable, pending, active, finalized, refund, and claimed accounting separate and reconcile every event.

sourceOfTruth.summary: Confirmed PoolManager and contract state for the exact chain and PoolId is the authoritative source of truth.
controls: Key every state read and emitted event by the exact chain, model revision and PoolId.

signaturesReplay.summary: The starter surface consumes no model-specific signed message or signed offchain payload.

externalCalls.summary: The launcher, hook, and router call only typed immutable PoolManager, PositionManager, WETH, and launched-token surfaces.
controls: Check all return values, reject arbitrary targets, guard reentrancy, and revert every partial external failure atomically.

custody.summary: OvertimeHook owns WETH PoolManager claims against explicit liabilities and LockedLiquidityVault permanently owns the initial position.
controls: Prove WETH claim solvency, beneficiary-only exits, no rescue, and no position approval, transfer, decrease, or withdrawal path.

piiGeolocation.summary: The onchain starter surface collects no private identity data or precise user geolocation.

secretBoundary.summary: The onchain starter surface assumes no secret can remain confidential in contract state or calldata.

sourceTestSchema.summary: The implementation manifest binds the exact source, tests, compiler input and specification reviewed for this boundary.
controls: Bind prototype source and tests to implementation paths and include every imported executable byte in the review target.

failureRecovery.summary: An invalid callback or state transition reverts atomically and does not block the separately declared user exit path.
controls: Test dependency failure, callback revert and recovery without partial settlement or trapped user funds.

externalCalls.reentrancyPolicy: Transient guards protect router and claim entry; state effects precede redemption; no arbitrary target or callback extension exists.
externalCalls.stateDriftPolicy: PoolKey and immutable dependency addresses are revalidated at each relevant action; launch and quote inputs use coherent current state.
externalCalls.returnValuePolicy: Safe ERC-20 transfer wrappers and exact PoolManager/PositionManager return, delta, and owner checks; malformed or false results revert.
externalCalls.failureAtomicity: Every external-call failure reverts its complete swap, challenge, claim, or launch transaction.

rationales.complexity: One hook combines four-quadrant return deltas, cumulative fees, rounds, refunds, and several pull claims with a launcher and custody vault.
rationales.customMath: Fee gross-up, cumulative remainders, crown cost, capped deadlines, and pro-rata crown-time require boundary and conservation proofs.
rationales.externalDependencies: Runtime depends on immutable Uniswap PoolManager, PositionManager, and canonical WETH with pinned source/runtime checks.
rationales.externalLiquidity: The hook does not place assets into an external yield or liquidity protocol; initial v4 liquidity stays in the canonical pool.
rationales.valueAtRisk: The hook may custody growing fee pots and finalized claims, while the initial liquidity position is deliberately permanent.
rationales.teamMaturity: No independently reviewed Overtime release or operating history exists, so maturity is conservatively scored at the maximum.
rationales.upgradeability: All Overtime contracts are immutable and have no proxy, admin, setter, pause, or rescue mechanism.
rationales.autonomy: Timestamp-triggered finalization and deadline extension are automatic but bounded by immutable formulas and require no keeper.
rationales.priceImpact: The hook charges a fixed disclosed fee and challenge crown payment but does not replace the AMM curve or use an oracle.

disclosures: Overtime v1 is an unaudited implementation candidate and has not been accepted, deployed, source-verified, routed, indexed, or made available by Programmable or Uniswap.
Ordinary swaps pay a fixed 110 bps hook-owned WETH fee; exactly 10 bps belongs to Programmable and 100 bps funds the game.
Challenge trades require the custom router and non-empty hookData; ordinary empty-data swaps remain separate.
Specified-WETH partial fills revert atomically, and every challenge partial fill reverts.
Initial liquidity is permanently locked with no rescue or migration path, and Overtime contracts have no pause, upgrade, setter, or administrator sweep.
Hooklist, Universal Router, UniswapX, indexer, scanner, and interface support are external states and are not claimed.
